{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Identify refunded orders
refunded = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']

# Filter data: exclude QA orders and rows with missing age (customer_age == -1), but include all converted customers (converted == 1), including refunded ones
filtered_data = data[
    (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) &
    (data['customer_age'] != -1) &
    (data['converted'] == 1)
]

# Compute the mean age of customers who converted (including refunded ones, excluding QA and missing age)
mean_age_converted = filtered_data['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean age of customers who converted: {mean_age_converted}")"}
